title: Rest and Spread Check
description: Shallow copy, override, and rest leftovers for objects and arrays.

questions.explanation: Rest gathers leftover keys. Spread copies then `b: 99` overrides — later keys win.

questions.prompt: What is true about object spread `{ ...state }` when `state` has nested objects?

options.text: Top-level is new; nested objects are still shared references

questions.explanation: Spread is shallow. Mutating `next.user.name` still changes `state.user.name`.

questions.prompt: In `{ ...a, ...b }`, which source wins on conflicting keys?
questions.explanation: Properties are copied left to right; later keys overwrite earlier ones.

questions.prompt: Where must object rest (`...rest`) appear in a destructuring pattern?
questions.explanation: Rest must be last so it can collect whatever was not already bound.

questions.prompt: How do you drop `id` from `{ id: 10, name: "Ada", active: true }` without listing every other key?
questions.explanation: Pull `id` out (even if unused) and rest collects the remaining own enumerable keys into a new object.
